posts.html:
@ventmob.com E-mail Addresses

Okay, so I have 49 of these to give away, first come first serve basis, one per customer, subject to terms and conditions 

The email address can be anythingyouwant@ventmob.com

If you would like one, please PM me the following, for example:

Firstname: John
Lastname: Smith
Email: J.Smith@ventmob.com

I will reply to you with the temporary password for your account, you can change this once you login. (http://mail.ventmob.com)
